'''R0-4L0''', referred to simply as '''ROLO''',<ref name="Flight Log">''[[Poe Dameron: Flight Log]]''</ref> was an [[R0-series astromech droid|R0]]<ref name="By the numbers" /> [[astromech droid]] that served in the [[Resistance]] thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]]. It served as [[Jessika Pava]]'s astromech aboard her [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] during the [[Battle of Starkiller Base|assault]] on [[Starkiller Base]].<ref name="Episode VII" />

==Behind the scenes==
R0-4L0 first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], a film released in North America on [[December 18]], [[2015]].

Hasbro released a large figure of R0-4L0 in a Target gift set with BB-8 and C-3PO.
